import ast,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,tempfile,yaml
repo=pathlib.Path('/workspace/eventhubs-kafka-dotnet')
workflow=yaml.safe_load(repo.joinpath('docs/operations/workflows/scenario.yml.txt').read_text())
commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()
git_dir=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','--absolute-git-dir'],cwd=repo,text=True).strip()
results=[]
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='a01-redaction-synthetic-') as temporary:
 root=pathlib.Path(temporary)
 for relative in ['docs/operations/a01-runtime-limits.json','docs/operations/service-tags.json']:
  target=root/relative; target.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); target.write_text('{}')
 private=root/'private'; private.mkdir()
 files={
  'PARCHWELL_PERSISTENT_OUTPUTS_PATH':{},
  'PARCHWELL_EPHEMERAL_BACKEND_CONFIG':{},
  'PARCHWELL_EPHEMERAL_TFVARS_PATH':{},
  'PARCHWELL_COST_INPUT_PATH':{'currency':'GBP','item':'A01','baseline_sources':[{}],'sources':[{}],'phase_estimates':{'probe':1,'C0':1,'C3':1}},
  'PARCHWELL_RUN_STORAGE_READINESS_PATH':{'schema_version':1,'environments':['parchwell-scenarios','parchwell-sweeper'],**dict.fromkeys(['shared_keys_disabled','public_access_disabled','private_endpoint_ready','private_dns_ready','ledger_read_create_conditional_update','evidence_create_read'],True)}
 }
 env={'PATH':os.environ['PATH'],'GIT_DIR':git_dir,'PARCHWELL_APPROVED_SOURCE_SHA':commit,'PARCHWELL_A01_RUNTIME_DIRECTORY':str(private),'RUNNER_TEMP':str(root),'GITHUB_ENV':str(root/'github-env')}
 for key,value in files.items():
  target=private/(key.lower()+'.json'); target.write_text(json.dumps(value)); env[key]=str(target)
 for job_name,job in workflow['jobs'].items():
  phase=job['env']['A01_PHASE']; env['A01_PHASE']=phase
  runtime_path=private/(phase+'.json')
  runtime_path.write_text(json.dumps({'schema_version':1,'source_commit':commit,'phase':phase,'initialize_ledger':phase=='probe'}))
  steps=job['steps']; prepare_index=next(i for i,s in enumerate(steps) if s.get('id')=='prepare'); phase_index=next(i for i,s in enumerate(steps) if s.get('id')=='phase')
  assert prepare_index<phase_index
  script=steps[prepare_index]['run']; assert 'umask 077' in script
  for subscription in [None,'malformed','ABCDEF01-ABCD-ABCD-ABCD-ABCDEF012345']:
   case_env=dict(env)
   if subscription is not None: case_env['AZURE_SUBSCRIPTION_ID']=subscription
   result=subprocess.run(['bash','-c',script],cwd=root,env=case_env,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=20)
   expected=subscription is not None and subscription!='malformed'
   assert (result.returncode==0)==expected
   if subscription is not None:
    assert subscription not in result.stdout and subscription not in result.stderr
   if expected:
    output=root/('a01-'+phase)/'runtime.json'; data=json.loads(output.read_text())
    assert data['subscription_guid']==subscription
    assert output.stat().st_mode & 0o077 == 0
   results.append({'job':job_name,'case':'valid' if expected else 'missing' if subscription is None else 'malformed','expected_exit_observed':True,'private_value_not_printed':True})
  uploads=[s for s in steps if str(s.get('uses','')).startswith('actions/upload-artifact@')]
  assert len(uploads)==1 and uploads[0]['with']['path']=='${{ env.A01_OUTPUT }}/phase/candidate.json'
print(json.dumps({'synthetic':True,'phase_jobs':3,'cases':results,'prepare_precedes_phase':True,'runtime_permissions_private':True,'artifact_upload_candidate_only':True},indent=2))

(out/'repository-inputs-pre-validation.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
